intent: Actually assemble questions and negatives with do-support versus existing be/modal/perfect auxiliaries; restore lexical base forms, retain participles, distinguish plural subjects and constrained subject-Who replacement.
picturePurpose: Coded before/after sentence diagrams and manipulable word tiles show actual movement and inflection. No decorative picture replaces the grammar operation.

workshop.title: 把句子拆开，再拼出问句和否定句
workshop.instruction: 已有be、情态动词或完成时have，先保留它们；需要do时，别让实义动词重复变化。

conditions.label: 加了Does，动词还加-s吗？
conditions.target: Does Mia paint badges every Friday
choices: Does Mia paints badges every Friday
Does Mia paint badges every Friday
conditions.reason: Does放到Mia前面，承担一般现在时的第三人称单数变化；paints要还原成paint。句首Does大写，Mia的名字也保留大写。

world.caption: 把肯定句改为一般疑问句。原句说的是每周五的习惯。

conditions.label: 亲手拼出否定句
conditions.target: Mia does not paint badges on Fridays
choices: Mia does not paints badges on Fridays
Mia does not paint badges on Fridays
conditions.reason: 把这件事改为否定时，在Mia后加does not，paints还原为paint。doesn't是does not的缩写，这里也可以使用。

world.caption: 把原句改成否定句，表达“Mia周五不画徽章”。这一步改变肯否，不能把两句当成同一个事实。

accepted: Mia doesn't paint badges on Fridays

conditions.label: 过去时的问句，变化放在哪里？
conditions.target: Did Leo clean the brushes yesterday
choices: Did Leo cleaned the brushes yesterday
Did Leo clean the brushes yesterday
conditions.reason: 原句的cleaned表示过去。改问句时用Did，后面的动词还原为clean；不能把Did和cleaned叠在一起。句首Did大写。

world.caption: 把昨天的清洗记录改为一般疑问句。

conditions.label: 修好否定句中的词形
choices: cleaned
clean
conditions.inputHint: 直接修改原稿。先看did not，再决定动词形式。
conditions.reason: did已经表示过去，not后面的实义动词用原形clean，不再加-ed。

world.caption: 否定记录：Leo昨天没有清洗这些画笔。原稿把过去时变化写了两遍。

conditions.label: 已有is，还需要Does吗？
conditions.target: Is Amy sorting the cards now
choices: Does Amy sorting the cards now
Is Amy sorting the cards now
conditions.reason: is sorting是正在进行的动作。提问时把Is移到Amy前，sorting保留；不能把Is换成Does。句首Is大写。

world.caption: 把此刻正在整理卡片的记录改为一般疑问句。

cells.label: Amy is sorting the cards now.

conditions.label: 已有can，把谁移到前面？
choices: Does Amy can design a poster
Can Amy design a poster
conditions.reason: 原句已有情态动词can，提问时把Can移到Amy前，design保持原形。不要再加Does；句首Can大写。

world.caption: 把能力描述改成一般疑问句。

conditions.label: 完成时的have要保留
conditions.target: Have Mia and Leo packed the cards yet
choices: Do Mia and Leo packed the cards yet
Have Mia and Leo packed the cards yet
conditions.reason: have packed构成现在完成时。提问时把Have移到Mia and Leo前，packed保留为过去分词；本题同时把already换成问句中的yet。

world.caption: 两人已经装好了卡片。改为一般疑问句，并用yet替换already。

cells.label: Mia and Leo have packed the cards already.

conditions.label: 没有动作词，也不能随便加Do
choices: Do the badges are ready
Are the badges ready
conditions.reason: 原句用are说明徽章的状态。提问时把Are移到the badges前，不再加Do；句首Are大写，后面的the不用大写。

world.caption: 把“徽章准备好了”改为一般疑问句。

conditions.label: 这次问的是谁做的
choices: Who did cleaned the brushes
Who cleaned the brushes
conditions.reason: 这里只把主语Someone换成Who，其余部分保留，cleaned仍用过去式。Who就在主语位置，按本题改写不加did。

world.caption: 只把Someone换成Who，询问“谁清洗了画笔”，其余词保持原样。

conditions.label: 主语换成两人，Does还对吗？
conditions.target: Do Mia and Leo paint badges on Fridays
choices: Does Mia and Leo paint badges on Fridays
Do Mia and Leo paint badges on Fridays
conditions.reason: Mia and Leo是复数主语，一般现在时问句用Do，不是Does。paint本来就是原形，保留即可；句首Do大写。

world.caption: 把两人周五的习惯改成一般疑问句，与第一项的一人作比较。

cells.label: Mia and Leo paint badges on Fridays.

choices: Does Mia paints badges every Friday
Does Mia paint badges every Friday

Mia does not paint badges on Fridays

items.label: 移动与还原
items.prompt: 用词块改句子，亲手决定谁前移、谁还原。
items.hint: 先认结构，再处理主语、助动词和实义动词。

transfer.stem:
询问座位状态，再说明Ben平时的习惯。两空依次填什么？
___ these seats free? Ben does not ___ this seat.

explanation.strategy: 先分清句子原有的是be，还是需要do帮助的实义动词。每个空独立检查。

steps.text: 第一句在问这些座位是否空着，free说明状态。
steps.reason: these seats是复数，用Are放到主语前提问；不能用Do代替be。

steps.text: 第二句已有does not，后面用use。
steps.reason: 第三人称单数变化由does承担，use保持原形，不能再写uses。

distractors.reason: 第一句说明座位状态，缺少be，用Are，不是Do。
does not后面用原形use；uses重复了第三人称单数变化。

explanation.pitfall: 不能把所有问句都套成Do/Does，也不能在does后继续给实义动词加-s。

visual.title: 两种结构，分别处理
visual.caption: 先认句子结构，再决定用谁、放哪里、后面是什么词形。

explanation.transfer: 如果第二句主语换成Ben and Amy，does not应改成什么？
